before.text: The June archive trial reduced median lookup time from 18 minutes to 11 minutes across 24 requests. We did not record the longest lookup time, and the trial used only material that had already been catalogued. These results do not establish how the system will work with uncatalogued material. I found the shared index easier to use, although I still prefer the paper cards for tracing earlier descriptions. Before extending the trial, the archive lead should check whether the volunteer rota can support it. The rota has not yet been approved. The review must distinguish this temporary trial from a permanent service. The public notice must explain that distinction. The trial report should also retain the 24-request denominator when presenting the change in median time. No decision on a permanent service has been made.
